definitions.full: H8372. ta תָּא noun masculine Ezek 40:21 chamber (Late Hebrew id. , perhaps Aramaism, compare Arabic dwell , abode (? akin to turn aside to lodge , אַוְונָא , lodging-place ), Aramaic תָּוָן (in Ezekiel 40 תָּוַיָּא תְּוָא, ), room, chamber ); — ׳ת absolute 40:7 +, construct 1Kin 4:28 ; suffix תאו Ezek 40:21 Kt (Qr תָּאָיו ), so 40:29 ; 40:33 ; 40:36 ; plural תָּאִים 40:7 +; תָּאוֺת 40:12 ; construct תָּאֵי 40:10 ; — chamber: הָרָצִים תָּא 1Kin 4:28 chamber of the guards = 2Chr 12:11 ; in Ezekiel's temple: Ezek 40:7 (twice in verse); 40:10 , 12 (twice in verse); 40:13 , 16 , 21 , 29 , 33 , 36 .
